events.description: A warrior with long hair and face paint engages in close-quarters combat with an armored opponent, swinging a weapon and making contact.
The same warrior is shown delivering a decisive blow, causing the opponent to fall to the ground; motion blur indicates rapid impact.
A fallen, injured opponent lies on the ground while the victor stands over him and repeatedly strikes him with a sword, indicating post-defeat violence against a helpless victim.
Another combatant (with blue face paint) is engaged in active fighting, wielding an axe amid surrounding chaos; visible motion and proximity suggest ongoing mutual combat.

Intense melee combat between Scottish warriors (including one with blue face paint) and English soldiers in chainmail and surcoats, involving swords, spears, and cavalry charges on a grassy battlefield.
A fallen English soldier in chainmail is attacked while on the ground by an opponent; visible in frames showing him prone with another figure striking or pressing down on him.
Close-quarters melee combat between two armored fighters: one with chainmail and a black coif, the other (William Wallace) with face paint and leather armor, exchanging sword strikes.
Large-scale violent clash between two armed groups on an open field, including infantry fighting on foot and cavalry charges; multiple simultaneous engagements with swords, shields, and spears.

A large, bloodied crowd of warriors erupts in collective violent celebration: shouting, raising weapons, and thrashing arms in unison, indicating post-battle riotous unrest rather than ongoing combat.
